Name: Quiet Chores
Author: Kizenor
Description:
[size=4][b]Tired of getting stopped by a modal dialogue box every time you accidentally click the wrong animal with a milk pail or shears, pet a sleeping animal at night, or swing a weak axe at a stump?

[b]Quiet Chores[/b] silently skips those dialogue boxes and turns them into standard bottom-left red HUD notifications instead — so your character never stops moving and you don't have to click to dismiss popups.

[size=4][b]What it replaces[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list]

[*][size=4][b][b]Milk Pail:[/b] "<Name> has no milk right now." and "<Name> doesn't produce milk."[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Shears:[/b] "<Name> has no wool right now." and "<Name> doesn't produce wool."[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Sleeping Animals:[/b] "<Name> is trying to sleep." (after 7:00 PM; normal daytime animal menu still opens as usual).[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Weak Axe / Pickaxe:[/b] "Your <tool> isn't strong enough..." when hitting stumps, logs, boulders, meteorites, or destructible bushes.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list]

[*][size=4][b][b]Works in any language[/b] (uses game hooks & localized game templates, not just English strings).[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Works with modded farm animals[/b] and animation-speed mods like Fast Animations.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Configurable:[/b] toggle each category individually or enable an optional cancel sound via [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] or[/b][/size]
[code]config.json[/code][size=4][b].[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b][b]Safe:[/b] never touches NPC dialogues, shops, mail, signs, quests, or cutscenes.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]
[size=4][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size][/b][/size]
[list=1]

[*][size=4][b]Install [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b].[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Download the main file and extract it into your[/b][/size]
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][size=4][b]folder (or install via Vortex).[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][b](Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for in-game settings. Built-in translations for GMCM: English, Russian.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b][b]На русском:[/b]
Мод убирает надоедливые модальные таблички (при дойке подойником, стрижке ножницами, клике по спящим животным вечером и ударах слабым топором/киркой по пням и валунам) и заменяет их на стандартные уведомления слева снизу с красным крестиком. Работает на любом языке игры, поддерживает настройку через Generic Mod Config Menu и[/b][/size]
[code]config.json[/code]


[size=4][b]AI Disclosure[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]This mod was built entirely using generative AI (C# SMAPI/Harmony code, i18n translations, and mod page description).[/*]
[*]Compiled, tested, and verified in-game on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.2 by the uploader.[/*]
[/list]
